newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan aims to privatise 49 pct AEM utility in 97.
newsitem.headline: Milan aims to privatise 49 pct AEM utility in 97.

text.p: The city of Milan aims to privatise 49 percent of its AEM gas and electricity utility and list it on the bourse by the end of this year, budget councillor Luigi Casero said.
He was speaking at AEM's annnual meeting, the first since it was transformed into a joint stock company in October last year.
The city council in January named Italian merchant bank and British investment bank BZW as joint advisers for the planned flotation.
Genoa's water and gas utility AMGA made its Milan bourse debut last October, the first Italian municipal utility to be floated.
Turin has also launched procedures to privatise its power utility.
